value.body: Some Company Secretaries add a second professional qualification — Chartered Accountancy (ICAI) or Cost & Management Accountancy (ICMAI). The combination joins company-law and governance skills with accounting, audit, tax or costing, which suits compliance-heavy finance roles.

items.label: Entry point
items.note: Graduates and some ICSI-qualified candidates can usually skip Foundation; conditions apply

items.label: CA students at Intermediate level
items.note: Out of ~10 lakh CA students in all

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Register with ICAI or ICMAI under their direct-entry rules (graduation marks or a qualifying ICSI level). Paper-wise exemptions exist only in limited cases and change over time, so check the institute's current exemption rules.

value.title: At a glance
items: Adding CA takes several more years, including articleship; CMA is generally shorter and has no articleship.
The combination helps most in listed-company compliance, secretarial audit, corporate finance and advisory roles.
Many CS professionals add an LLB or an MBA instead, depending on the career they want.

value.title: CA students by level
value.note: Covers all CA students, not only CS-qualified ones; direct-entry candidates start at Intermediate.
